title: This life is more than a schedule
summary: Human birth is framed as an opening for meeting, sangat, and Naam.
takeaway: Do not let busyness bury the point of being here.
lifeApplication: Choose one practice today that treats life as an opportunity for meeting rather than maintenance.

source.shortMeaning: Human birth is given as the chance to meet the Divine.
source.lifeApplication: Let one part of the day answer that opportunity directly.

evidence.coreClaim: Human birth is given as the chance to meet the Divine.
evidence.turn: Use this life for meeting, not merely for managing.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose one practice today that treats life as an opportunity for meeting rather than maintenance.
